description: Exact calendar maths. With end: days between two dates (plus weeks, months+days, weekdays Mon-Fri, weekend days). With add_days/add_weeks/add_months/add_years (negative to subtract): the resulting date and weekday; business_days=true skips weekends. Use this instead of counting days yourself.

include_end.description: Count the end date too (default false)

timezone.description: IANA zone used for today when start is omitted (default UTC)

name: date_calc
